terra.problem: The line implies Josiah fell at the Euphrates, but he was shot at Megiddo. The Josiah moment also combines Neco’s planned campaign at Carchemish with a battle at Megiddo, away from the river.
The Ruined Loincloth moment identifies Perath as the Euphrates with certainty. Perath is often identified with the Euphrates, but its location in Jeremiah 13 is debated; the BSB calls it Perath.
The line is long and dense for a 5th-grade reading level. Words such as “confront” and “crevice” may also need simpler alternatives.
